combinations.subject: three faceted crystals bound together by a bronze triangle clasp, with a ghostly fan of other bronze triangle clasps fading behind it

permutations.subject: a bronze revolving drum with six faceted crystal chambers, spun mid-motion, the crystals blurring into a fan

grid-search.subject: a flat bronze plate with a four-by-four lattice of small faceted crystals, brightening from pale cyan in one corner to deep amber in the opposite corner

n-queens.subject: a small bronze chessboard corner with three cyan crystal queens on it, none sharing a row or diagonal, and faint gold lines showing their reach

branch-and-bound.subject: a bronze shield with a tree etched into it, most branches crossed out with short gold strokes, one branch leading to a glowing cyan crystal at its tip

meet-in-the-middle.subject: two bronze bridges reaching toward each other from left and right, each carrying a faceted crystal, meeting with a bright amber flash at the centre

bogosort.subject: a bronze dice cup tipped over, faceted crystals tumbling out in every direction, one tiny neat sorted row of crystals among them

selection-sort.subject: a bronze pointer hand picking the smallest faceted crystal out of a jumbled row and placing it on a shelf at the left

all-pairs-rank.subject: a ring of five faceted crystals with thin gold lines joining every pair, forming a star polygon
